admin.page.stats.caption: Calls per skill · Under each host name is the basis that host is counted by
admin.page.stats.desc: See which host called which Sennard skill and how many times. This is a view-only screen, so no passkey is needed.
admin.page.stats.empty: No calls have been recorded yet.
admin.page.stats.loadFailed: The statistics could not be loaded. {reason} {code}
admin.page.stats.noteBasis: Each host opens skills in a different way, so the counting basis differs. A SKILL.md read counts the times the body was opened, so reading the same skill again counts again. Compare the numbers between hosts with this difference in mind.
admin.page.stats.noteMissing: Calls that do not appear on this screen: skills that a host opened in a way it does not show to the hook (for example when the user called one directly by slash or name and the body went in at once) and skills outside Sennard. For a host that gives no subagent marker, subagent calls are also counted as main. Records are kept for {days} days.
admin.page.stats.title: Skill statistics
admin.page.top.keys: Registered passkeys: {count} · confirmed when you save
admin.page.top.languageConfirm: Changing the language reloads the page. Unsaved changes, searches, filters and the selected period will be reset. Change the language anyway?

admin.page.workflows.desc: Review workflow starts, recent runs and the skills declared during the selected period.

admin.page.workflows.title: Workflow statistics
